detail.longDescription: Anthropic's Claude family has four primary models: Haiku, Sonnet, Opus, and Fable. (There's also Mythos, but the general public doesn't have access to that.) All four Claude models are incredibly capable. Even the smallest model, Haiku, is better than the best frontier models from two years ago. This makes teasing out the differences between them a challenge. Benchmarks are one tool to help. Zapier's AutomationBench, for example, tests AI agents on end-to-end workflow execution using real tools
